description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainViewModel class for an Android app, managing authentication states, user actions (login, lock, unlock, call protected resource, logout), and logging for the app's UI. It interacts with AuthManager, ApiClient, and handles state flows and coroutine-based asynchronous operations.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing authentication state, user actions, and logging for the main UI of the app.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via mock API, updates auth state, and logs the process.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, keeping tokens stored.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the session after biometric/device credential verification.

methods.name: callProtected
methods.description: Calls a protected API endpoint, demonstrating network request handling.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens and sets auth state to logged out.
